definitions.explanation: A color such as blue, blue-green or blue-violet that gives an impression of coolness and calm and seems to recede. The opposite is {暖色|だんしょく} (warm color).

examples.japanese: {寒色|かんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
{寒色|かんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: A room in cool colors feels calming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝室|しんしつ}→寝室：05300_shinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れる→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧や⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寒色|かんしょく}{系|けい}にした。
examples.english: I chose curtains in cool colors like blue and green for the bedroom so I could sleep well.

notes:
Made of {寒|かん} (cold) + {色|しょく} (color). A word of art, design and interior decoration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒色系|かんしょくけい}: cool-toned, in the cool colors
- {寒色|かんしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{暖色|だんしょく}: cool and warm colors

WATCH OUT:
Other words read かんしょく include ⟦{感触|かんしょく}→感触：12743_kanshoku⟧ (feel, texture) and ⟦{完食|かんしょく}→完食：12346_kanshoku⟧ (eating everything up); context tells them apart.
